Definition
[Admissible class for systems] 1. ch8:8.2.4-def-1\group Existence of Minimizers Set \[ \mathcal{A} = \{ \mathbf{w} \in W^{1,q}(U; \R ^m) \mid \mathbf{w} = \mathbf{g} \text{ on } \partial U \text{ in the trace sense}\} , \] where $\mathbf{g} : \partial U \to \R ^m$ is given.
